import bpy,json,hashlib,numpy as np,struct,zlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent;cap=root/'captures/shipyard_working_structure_20261115';tex=root/'assets/coast/textures';craft=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Craft']
assert not craft.get('work15_surfaces')
def object_hash(o):
 h=hashlib.sha256();h.update(np.array(o.matrix_world,dtype=np.float32).tobytes())
 for v in o.data.vertices:h.update(np.array(v.co,dtype=np.float32).tobytes())
 for p in o.data.polygons:h.update(np.array(p.vertices,dtype=np.int32).tobytes())
 for uv in o.data.uv_layers:
  a=np.empty(len(uv.data)*2,np.float32);uv.data.foreach_get('uv',a);h.update(a.tobytes())
 h.update('|'.join(m.name for m in o.data.materials if m).encode());return h.hexdigest()
preserve={o.name:object_hash(o) for o in craft.objects if o.type=='MESH' and (o.name.startswith('Combined_front_A timber repair boat') or o.name.startswith(('B15','M14 working','M14 shore','S15','M14 continuous')) or o.name.startswith('Steel roof panel') or o.name.startswith('Steel wall'))}
(cap/'preserve_geometry_before.json').write_text(json.dumps(preserve,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
def png(name,a,color=True):
 a=np.round(np.clip(a,0,1)*255).astype(np.uint8)[::-1]
 if a.shape[2]==3:a=np.concatenate([a,np.full((*a.shape[:2],1),255,np.uint8)],axis=2)
 h,w=a.shape[:2]
 def chunk(k,d):return struct.pack('>I',len(d))+k+d+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(k+d)&0xffffffff)
 path=tex/(name+'.png');assert not path.exists(),str(path)
 path.write_bytes(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+chunk(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',w,h,8,6,0,0,0))+chunk(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(b''.join(b'\x00'+row.tobytes() for row in a),6))+chunk(b'IEND',b''))
 im=bpy.data.images.load(str(path),check_existing=False);im.colorspace_settings.name='sRGB' if color else 'Non-Color';im.pack();return im
def pixels(im):
 t=bpy.data.images.load(bpy.path.abspath(im.filepath),check_existing=False);t.colorspace_settings.name='Non-Color';t.reload()
 a=np.empty(len(t.pixels),np.float32);t.pixels.foreach_get(a);a=a.reshape(t.size[1],t.size[0],4);bpy.data.images.remove(t);return a
def woodmat(name,source,role):
 m=bpy.data.materials[source].copy();m.name=name;p=m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF');n=p.inputs['Base Color'].links[0].from_node
 a=pixels(n.image);rgb=a[:,:,:3];lum=(rgb*np.array([.2126,.7152,.0722])).sum(axis=2,keepdims=True)
 if role=='deck':a[:,:,:3]=(rgb*.25+lum*.75)*np.array([1.035,1.015,.96])
 else:a[:,:,:3]=(rgb*.70+lum*.30)*np.array([.75,.78,.79])
 n.image=png(name+'_albedo',a)
 return m
deck=woodmat('W15_SaltGreySlipway','Shipyard_Painterly_Worked_HarborCraft_TerminalTimber_deck','deck')
rail=woodmat('W15_DarkBearingTimber','Shipyard_Painterly_Worked_HarborCraft_TerminalTimber_frame','rail')
changed=[]
for o in craft.objects:
 if o.name.startswith(('Combined_front_A basin cross sleeper','Combined_front_A slip ramp tread')):
  o.data=o.data.copy();o.data.materials.clear();o.data.materials.append(deck);changed.append(o.name)
 elif o.name.startswith(('Combined_front_A longitudinal repair rail','Combined_front_A inclined hull cradle','Combined_front_A keel block','Combined_front_A ramp bearer')):
  o.data=o.data.copy();o.data.materials.clear();o.data.materials.append(rail);changed.append(o.name)
# Each roof light keeps its whole opening; restrained pane variation and edge dirt
# give glass a material response without painting a fixed lighting direction.
N=512;u,v=np.meshgrid((np.arange(N)+.5)/N,(np.arange(N)+.5)/N)
panex=np.minimum((u*3).astype(int),2);paney=np.minimum((v*2).astype(int),1)
pu=(u*3)%1;pv=(v*2)%1
edge=np.minimum(np.minimum(pu,1-pu),np.minimum(pv,1-pv))
grime=np.exp(-edge*38)*.42
arr=[];orms=[]
for variant in range(2):
 variation=np.array([[.0,.035,-.025],[-.018,.015,.045]])[paney,panex]
 broad=.012*np.sin(u*10+v*2+variant)+.008*np.cos(v*9-u*3)
 rgb=np.ones((N,N,3))*np.array([82,99,101])/255
 rgb*=1+variation[:,:,None]+broad[:,:,None]
 rgb=rgb*(1-grime[:,:,None])+np.array([107,103,87])/255*grime[:,:,None]
 arr.append(rgb)
 orm=np.zeros((N,N,3));orm[:,:,0]=1;orm[:,:,1]=.245+grime*.55+variation*.30;orms.append(orm)
glass=bpy.data.materials.new('W15_DustyRoofGlass');glass.use_nodes=True;p=glass.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF');p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value=0
t=glass.node_tree.nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexImage');t.image=png('W15_DustyRoofGlass_albedo',np.concatenate(arr,axis=1));glass.node_tree.links.new(t.outputs['Color'],p.inputs['Base Color'])
q=glass.node_tree.nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexImage');q.image=png('W15_DustyRoofGlass_orm',np.concatenate(orms,axis=1),False)
s=glass.node_tree.nodes.new('ShaderNodeSeparateColor');glass.node_tree.links.new(q.outputs['Color'],s.inputs['Color']);glass.node_tree.links.new(s.outputs['Green'],p.inputs['Roughness'])
lights=sorted([o for o in craft.objects if o.name.startswith('Combined_rear_B inset skylight glazing')],key=lambda o:o.name)
assert len(lights)==2
for j,o in enumerate(lights):
 o.data=o.data.copy();o.data.materials.clear();o.data.materials.append(glass);uv=o.data.uv_layers.active
 # Existing local y positions are offset from the combined workshop origin.
 y0=min(v.co.y for v in o.data.vertices)
 for loop in o.data.loops:
  co=o.data.vertices[loop.vertex_index].co;uv.data[loop.index].uv=((j+(co.x-1.1)/1.7)*.5,(co.y-y0)/1.2)
craft['work15_surfaces']=True
(cap/'surfaces.json').write_text(json.dumps({'wood_objects':changed,'roof_glass':[o.name for o in lights],'materials':[deck.name,rail.name,glass.name],'preserved_object_count':len(preserve)},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
bpy.app.driver_namespace['work15']={'root':root,'cap':cap,'craft':craft,'object_hash':object_hash,'png':png}
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
print('W15_SURFACES',len(changed),'wood objects;',len(lights),'roof lights;',len(preserve),'objects frozen for preservation audit')
